annotations.title: Protect a site with a login

description:
Put a sign-in screen in front of any roost so visitors must authenticate. Works on free, workspace, and forever hatches. Pass `hatchId` plus an `action`:
• `enable` with `mode: "password"` and a `password` → ONE shared site password (everyone uses the same one). Best for a private demo or staging link.
• `setPassword` with a new `password` → rotate the shared password.
• `disable` → remove the login and serve the site publicly again.
• `status` → report whether auth is on and which mode.
Returns `{ enabled, mode, loginUrl }`. The sign-in screen lives at `/__roost/login`. Prefer `password` mode; `useraccounts` is unavailable (per-hatch databases are no longer provisioned).

hatchId.description: Hatch id from the original hatch response.

mode.description: `password` = one shared site password (recommended). `useraccounts` is unavailable. Required when `action` is `enable`.

password.description: The shared site password (password mode only). Required for `enable` (password mode) and `setPassword`.

sessionToken.description: Optional paired session token from poll_pairing (when Authorization headers are unavailable).

tenantId.description: Legacy alias for `hatchId` from the original hatch response.

name: auth
title: Protect a site with a login
